listDescription: Service Desk ticket categories with SLA targets and default assignments per department.

fields.Description: Name of the support category (e.g., Password Reset, Onboarding).

fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Choice" DisplayName="Department" Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE" ID="{1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d}" StaticName="Department" Name="Department" Description="Department this category belongs to."><Default></Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>IT</CHOICE><CHOICE>HR</CHOICE><CHOICE>Operations</CHOICE><CHOICE>Finance</CHOICE><CHOICE>Facilities</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

fields.Description: Detailed description of what this category covers.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Note" DisplayName="Description" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="4" ID="{2b3c4d5e-6f7a-8b9c-0d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e}" StaticName="CategoryDescription" Name="CategoryDescription" Description="Detailed description of what this category covers." />

fields.Description: Whether this category is currently available for new tickets.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Boolean" DisplayName="Is Active" Required="FALSE" ID="{3c4d5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f}" StaticName="IsActive" Name="IsActive" Description="Whether this category is currently available for new tickets."><Default>1</Default></Field>

fields.Description: Default priority assigned to tickets created under this category.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Choice" DisplayName="Default Priority" Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE" ID="{4d5e6f7a-8b9c-0d1e-2f3a-4b5c6d7e8f9a}" StaticName="DefaultPriority" Name="DefaultPriority" Description="Default priority assigned to tickets created under this category."><Default>Medium</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>Low</CHOICE><CHOICE>Medium</CHOICE><CHOICE>High</CHOICE><CHOICE>Critical</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

fields.Description: Target resolution time in hours for this category.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Number" DisplayName="SLA Hours" Required="FALSE" Min="1" Max="720" Decimals="0" ID="{5e6f7a8b-9c0d-1e2f-3a4b-5c6d7e8f9a0b}" StaticName="SLAHours" Name="SLAHours" Description="Target resolution time in hours for this category." />

fields.Description: Default agent or group assigned to tickets in this category.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="User" DisplayName="Default Assignee" Required="FALSE" UserSelectionMode="PeopleOnly" UserSelectionScope="0" ID="{6f7a8b9c-0d1e-2f3a-4b5c-6d7e8f9a0b1c}" StaticName="DefaultAssignee" Name="DefaultAssignee" Description="Default agent or group assigned to tickets in this category." />

contentTypes.name: Service Desk Category
contentTypes.description: Content type for service desk ticket categories.

sampleData.Title: Password Reset
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests to reset or unlock user account passwords across all systems including Active Directory, email, and line-of-business applications.

sampleData.Title: Software Installation
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests to install, update, or remove software applications on company devices.

sampleData.Title: Network Issue
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Reports of network connectivity problems including Wi-Fi, VPN, LAN, and internet access issues.

sampleData.Title: Hardware Request
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests for new hardware, replacements, or repairs including laptops, monitors, peripherals, and mobile devices.

sampleData.Title: Email & Calendar Issue
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Problems with email delivery, calendar sharing, mailbox access, distribution lists, and Outlook configuration.

sampleData.Title: Security Incident
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Reports of suspected security breaches, phishing attempts, malware, unauthorized access, or data loss incidents.

sampleData.Title: Onboarding
sampleData.CategoryDescription: New employee onboarding tasks including account creation, equipment provisioning, orientation scheduling, and benefits enrollment.

sampleData.Title: Offboarding
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Employee departure tasks including account deactivation, equipment collection, exit interview scheduling, and final pay processing.

sampleData.Title: Benefits Inquiry
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Questions and requests related to health insurance, retirement plans, PTO balances, and other employee benefits.

sampleData.Title: Payroll Issue
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Reports of payroll discrepancies, direct deposit changes, tax withholding updates, and pay statement inquiries.

sampleData.Title: Training Request
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests for employee training, certification programs, professional development courses, and conference attendance.

sampleData.Title: Inventory Management
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests related to inventory tracking, stock replenishment, inventory discrepancies, and warehouse operations.

sampleData.Title: Shipping & Logistics
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Issues with shipment tracking, delivery scheduling, freight coordination, and logistics vendor management.

sampleData.Title: Process Improvement
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Suggestions and requests for operational process changes, workflow optimization, and efficiency improvements.

sampleData.Title: Vendor Management
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests related to vendor onboarding, contract management, performance issues, and vendor communications.

sampleData.Title: Quality Control Issue
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Reports of quality defects, non-conformances, inspection failures, and corrective action requests.

sampleData.Title: Expense Report
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests related to expense report submission, approval status, reimbursement processing, and policy questions.

sampleData.Title: Purchase Order Request
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests to create, modify, or approve purchase orders for goods and services.

sampleData.Title: Budget Inquiry
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Questions about departmental budgets, cost center allocations, and budget transfer requests.

sampleData.Title: Building Maintenance
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests for building repairs, HVAC issues, plumbing, electrical work, and general facility maintenance.

sampleData.Title: Room Booking Issue
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Problems with conference room reservations, AV equipment setup, room access, and meeting space availability.

sampleData.Title: Office Supplies
sampleData.CategoryDescription: Requests for office supplies, kitchen stock replenishment, and common area consumables.
